cases.ancestry_or_population: Spanish (two unrelated families, same TSD; possible founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2,440-bp antisense SVA in SERPINC1 intron 6 found by nanopore sequencing in two unrelated probands co-segregates with antithrombin deficiency; the authors speculate transcriptional interference or altered splicing but the exact mechanism could not be investigated.
cases.quote: Remarkably, two cases (P9 and P10) presented an insertion of 2,440 bp in intron 6.
